node.title: SPI stage 1: effective component control — count and degrees of irreducible components
node.statement: #Irr(I_{u,v}) <= t+1 and Segre degree <= j+t+1 for the Hankel slope-incidence variety (one horizontal scroll + <= r <= t vertical rank-drop fibers); same per paid stratum. Far stronger than the poly target. (Pro G, refereed, verified.)
